_comment: Pinned dependencies bundled into the app. download-dependencies verifies every archive against sha256. An empty sha256 means the pin is not recorded yet: the script prints the digest it saw and fails, and the value is then recorded here.

dependencies.name: ffmpeg
dependencies.purpose: Video, audio and image conversion and media details (ffmpeg.exe, ffprobe.exe and their shared libraries)
dependencies.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (FFmpeg master build N-128293-gb034eb5e7e with libx264); source: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds

dependencies.name: mingit
dependencies.purpose: Portable Git for :push and the public IP history repository

dependencies.name: roboto
dependencies.purpose: Roboto, the Material 3 typeface, embedded so every surface renders the same type on any Windows install

dependencies.name: 7zr
dependencies.purpose: Opens the 7-Zip extra package at download time so 7za.exe can be taken from it (build tool only, not bundled into the app)
dependencies.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (7-Zip 26.05, 7zr.exe; contains no unRAR code); source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip

dependencies.name: 7zip-full
dependencies.purpose: 7z.exe with 7z.dll, the full 7-Zip command line: reads RAR archives (RAR4 and RAR5) in the Extract an archive window
dependencies.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later with the unRAR license restriction (7-Zip 26.05, 7z.exe and 7z.dll; the unRAR code is used only to decode RAR archives and may not be used to create a RAR compressor); source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip

dependencies.name: 7zip
dependencies.purpose: 7za.exe, the standalone 7-Zip command line: 7z archives, encrypted zip, AES-256, split volumes and the archive test step
dependencies.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (7-Zip 26.05 extra package, 7za.exe; contains no unRAR code); source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip
